# Pinokio-MCP Full Reference

MCP server for controlling Pinokio — the 1-click localhost cloud for AI apps.

## MCP Tools
- `discover_apps` — Discover installed apps
- `get_app_status` — Check app running status
- `launch_app` — Launch a Pinokio app
- `stop_app` — Stop a running app
- `list_categories` — List app categories

## Configuration
| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `PINOKIO_HOST` | Pinokio host | localhost |
| `PINOKIO_PORT` | Pinokio port | auto-discover |
| `PINOKIO_HOME` | Pinokio home dir | auto-discover |
